item.title: With Rain in Forecast, Rose Parade Viewers Flock to Pasadena
item.description: Despite a rare prediction of rain in the New Year’s Day forecast, thousands of people began flocking to Pasadena Wednesday to snag viewing positions for the 137th Rose Parade, which could be the first one dampened by precipitation in more than 20 years.
